data.name: RemoteServerNotFound
data.value: That remote server does not exist.

data.name: RemoteServerNameTaken
data.value: Another remote server already has that name.

data.name: RemoteServerEndpointTaken
data.value: A remote server with that host, port and login is already registered.

data.name: RemoteServerHostKeyUnconfirmed
data.value: Confirm the server's host key first. Nothing connects until you have compared its fingerprint.

data.name: RemoteServerHostKeyChanged
data.value: The server presented a different host key than the one you confirmed, so nothing was read. Scan its host keys again and confirm the new fingerprint only if you expected the change.

data.name: RemoteServerHostKeyFingerprintMismatch
data.value: That fingerprint is not one the server offered. Compare it with the one shown on the server itself and type it exactly.

data.name: RemoteServerAuthRefused
data.value: The server refused the panel's key. Add the public key to the login's authorized keys on that server and test again.

data.name: RemoteServerUnreachable
data.value: The server could not be reached. Check the host and port and that its SSH service is running.

data.name: RemoteServerAddressRefused
data.value: The panel does not connect to that address. It is this server itself, or a loopback, link-local or otherwise reserved address.

data.name: RemoteServerNotReady
data.value: The server needs a confirmed host key and no unresolved connection problem before it can be read. Test the connection first.

data.name: MigrationAgentUnavailable
data.value: The panel could not reach its agent to talk to the remote server. Try again shortly.

data.name: MigrationDiscoveryFailed
data.value: The operation on the remote server failed. Test the connection and try again.

data.name: MigrationAccountNotFound
data.value: That account does not exist.

data.name: MigrationExportNotFound
data.value: That export does not exist or has expired.

data.name: MigrationImportNotFound
data.value: That import does not exist.

data.name: MigrationGrantNotFound
data.value: That grant does not exist.

data.name: MigrationBackupsUnavailable
data.value: This panel has no backup service, so there is nothing to move an account with.

data.name: MigrationPackageMalformed
data.value: The package is damaged or is not a package made by a Maran server.

data.name: MigrationPackageTooLarge
data.value: The package is larger than this server will accept.

data.name: MigrationPackageSchemaUnknown
data.value: The package was made by a version of Maran that this server cannot read.

data.name: MigrationSignatureInvalid
data.value: The package signature does not verify. Nothing was imported.

data.name: MigrationFingerprintMismatch
data.value: The key fingerprint is not the one you confirmed on the sending server. Nothing was imported.

data.name: MigrationAccountNameConfirmationMismatch
data.value: The account name you typed does not match. The import was not started.

data.name: MigrationImportNotReady
data.value: This import is not waiting to be started.

data.name: MigrationImportHasConflicts
data.value: The dry run found conflicts. Resolve them and try again.

data.name: MigrationInitiatorGone
data.value: The administrator who started the import can no longer act, so it was stopped before anything was created.

data.name: MigrationImportFaulted
data.value: The import failed unexpectedly and was rolled back.

data.name: MigrationRollbackUnavailable
data.value: The import failed and this panel cannot delete the account it created. Delete it by hand.

data.name: MigrationSecretsAlreadyClaimed
data.value: The generated passwords were already shown once and are no longer kept.

data.name: MigrationSectionNotImportable
data.value: This server has no module that can import this part of the package, so it will be skipped.

data.name: MigrationPullUnreachable
data.value: The other server could not be reached, or it stopped answering. Check the address and try again.

data.name: MigrationPullAddressRefused
data.value: That address cannot be used for a pull: it is this server, or a loopback or link-local address, or it resolves only to such addresses.

data.name: MigrationPullRefused
data.value: The other server did not accept the grant. It may be wrong, expired, already used or tied to another address; issue a new one there.

data.name: MigrationJobNotFound
data.value: That migration does not exist.

data.name: MigrationJobAccountNotFound
data.value: That account is not part of the migration.

data.name: MigrationJobNotEditable
data.value: The mapping can only be changed before the migration starts.

data.name: MigrationJobStateInvalid
data.value: The migration is not in a state that allows that.

data.name: MigrationJobNoAccounts
data.value: Choose at least one account to migrate.

data.name: MigrationJobHasConflicts
data.value: The migration has conflicts. Resolve them in the dry run before starting.

data.name: MigrationAccountStateInvalid
data.value: The account is not in a state that allows that.

data.name: MigrationMappingIncomplete
data.value: Choose a plan, an owner e-mail and a primary domain for this account.

data.name: MigrationLimitInvalid
data.value: The concurrency must be 1 to 8 and the bandwidth limit a positive number.

data.name: MigrationDuplicateInJob
data.value: Two accounts in this migration claim the same domain.

data.name: MigrationDatabaseNameNotImportable
data.value: This database cannot keep its name here. Names are never changed; rename it on the source or leave it out.

data.name: MigrationSiteProxyNotImported
data.value: This site is a reverse proxy and its upstream is not known, so it was left out. Create it by hand.

data.name: MigrationCronNotMigrated
data.value: Scheduled tasks are only counted on the source and are not transferred. Recreate them after the move.

data.name: MigrationMailNotMigrated
data.value: Mail is not migrated. Move the mailboxes separately.

data.name: MigrationGrantMissing
data.value: A source that is a Maran panel needs its address, its confirmed key fingerprint and a pull grant for every account.

data.name: MigrationTransferFaulted
data.value: The transfer stopped because of a fault on this server. Details are in the server log.

data.name: MigrationDiskInsufficient
data.value: This server does not have enough free disk space for the transfer.

data.name: MigrationPullFailed
data.value: Copying the files failed. The source may have unreadable files or the connection dropped.

data.name: MigrationPullIncomplete
data.value: Copying the files did not finish within its time allowance. Retry to continue from where it stopped.

data.name: MigrationDumpFailed
data.value: Dumping a database on the source failed.

data.name: MigrationDumpTooLarge
data.value: A database dump is larger than the allowance.

data.name: MigrationDumpRefused
data.value: A database dump holds something a single-database user cannot load (a trigger, routine, event or view) and was refused. Nothing was loaded with more privilege.

data.name: MigrationDumpLoadFailed
data.value: The server refused a statement of a database dump.

data.name: MigrationAccountCancelled
data.value: The account was cancelled.

data.name: RemoteServerInUse
data.value: A migration still uses this server. Remove or finish the migration first.
